sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases star elemental attack by 8 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Healing Ability Power 20. Heals HP. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
